entries.text: You see Sammael, one of the Scavs from Adytum.
entries.source_text: You see Sammael, one of the Scavs from Adytum.

entries.text: You see a grungy man in dark blue clothes.
entries.source_text: You see a grungy man in dark blue clothes.

entries.text: Hey, I don't believe we've met. You are?
entries.source_text: Hey, I don't believe we've met. You are?

entries.text: I'm
entries.source_text: I'm

entries.text: Who's asking?
entries.source_text: Who's asking?

entries.text: Eruh?
entries.source_text: Eruh?

entries.text: The pleasure's mine. I'm called Sammael.
entries.source_text: The pleasure's mine. I'm called Sammael.

entries.text: What do you do here?
entries.source_text: What do you do here?

entries.text: Nice talking to you.
entries.source_text: Nice talking to you.

entries.text: Nobody special. Never mind.
entries.source_text: Nobody special. Never mind.

entries.text: I'm a Scav -- a scavenger. My job is to search out all of the Boneyard for useful items and information. Dangerous work.
entries.source_text:
I'm a Scav -- a scavenger. My job is to search out all of
 the Boneyard for useful items and information. Dangerous work.

entries.text: Why is it dangerous?
entries.source_text: Why is it dangerous?

entries.text: How do you avoid the Deathclaws?
entries.source_text: How do you avoid the Deathclaws?

entries.text: Have you scouted out any of the other areas?
entries.source_text: Have you scouted out any of the other areas?

entries.text: Thanks, bye.
entries.source_text: Thanks, bye.

entries.text: See you around. If you see me. Heh.
entries.source_text: See you around. If you see me. Heh.

entries.text: Well, you got the DeathClaws out there, and then you got the Regulators back here in Adytum.  Both ain't the most forgiving types.
entries.source_text:

entries.text: We only work at night, and we're good at what we do.  But I'll admit not everyone always comes back.  I sent a guy out last week to look for some parts for Miles, and we haven't heard from him since. The last transmission I got from him was that he'd found the parts, and was on his way back.

We only work at night, and we're good at what
 we do.  But I'll admit not everyone always comes back.  I sent a guy out
 last week to look for some parts for Miles, and we haven't heard from him since.
 The last transmission I got from him was that he'd found the parts,
 and was on his way back.

entries.text: I've done a little scouting. Who do you want to know about?
entries.source_text: I've done a little scouting. Who do you want to know about?

entries.text: The Blades.
entries.source_text: The Blades.

entries.text: The Deathclaws.
entries.source_text: The Deathclaws.

entries.text: The Gun Runners.
entries.source_text: The Gun Runners.

entries.text: The Followers of the Apocalypse.
entries.source_text: The Followers of the Apocalypse.

entries.text: The Children of the Cathedral.
entries.source_text: The Children of the Cathedral.

entries.text: Nobody, thanks.
entries.source_text: Nobody, thanks.

entries.text: The Blades are a pretty sorry sight for a group of people. They get by though, and some of them end up here in Adytum if they agree to what the Regulators offer them to do.
entries.source_text:
The Blades are a pretty sorry sight for a group of people.
 They get by though, and some of them end up here in Adytum if they agree
 to what the Regulators offer them to do.

entries.text: Well if you haven't seen them before. They're mean as all hell, and like nothing more than to rip a poor Scav's heart out.
entries.source_text:

 and like nothing more than to rip a poor Scav's heart out.

entries.text: I've heard there's a nest of them somewhere to the east of the Blades, but I haven't seen it myself.
entries.source_text:
I've heard there's a nest of them somewhere to the east of the Blades,
 but I haven't seen it myself.

entries.text: The Gun Runners moved into a big factory up to north-east not long ago. Can't tell you much because they have a moat filled with radioactive sludge, and you gotta get through the Deathclaws to get there.
entries.source_text:
The Gun Runners moved into a big factory up to north-east not

 to get there.

entries.text: The Followers preach peace and tolerance. Nice idea, but impractical. They live in a big library to the north-west of us.
entries.source_text:
The Followers preach peace and tolerance. Nice idea, but

entries.text: The Children of the Cathedral are based out of a big church a ways to the south of here. There are some strange things going on there. I've seen creatures that can't be human coming in and out of there.
entries.source_text:
The Children of the Cathedral are based out of a big church

 coming in and out of there.

entries.text: And if the stories are right, the church is built over an old Vault, which Adytum's predecessors lived in.

entries.text: Heya. We see each other once more. What's up?
entries.source_text: Heya. We see each other once more. What's up?

entries.text: What was your job, again?
entries.source_text: What was your job, again?

entries.text: Nothing, thanks.
entries.source_text: Nothing, thanks.

entries.text: Oh, I see. Right. Bye!
